# Simple Podcast Manager v1.9.0
- Automatically prepares the latest 1, 2, 3, or all new episodes after feed refreshes. - Sets a first-refresh baseline so existing feed backlogs are not downloaded. - Lets each show opt out of automatic downloads or be disabled entirely. - Keeps device sync manual so every copy and deletion can still be reviewed. - Groups Refresh, Edit, and Remove controls under the selected show.
